content:
OpenAI is working on a feature that lets users export ChatGPT-generated stickers directly to WhatsApp. Here are the details.

The feature is still in development.

No matter where you are or how old you are, you probably can't go a day—or even a few hours—without sending or receiving a WhatsApp sticker.

For those unfamiliar, messaging app stickers are small images users send in chat threads, similar to emojis or GIFs. They are typically organised into sticker packs and can feature custom illustrations or meme-style images with text.

WhatsApp itself already has a built-in AI sticker generation feature powered by Meta AI, which lets users create images via text prompts. Now, according to Android Authority, OpenAI appears to be working on bringing a similar sticker generation feature to ChatGPT.

According to the website, the latest version of the ChatGPT Android app contains strings related to creating, exporting, and downloading stickers. They are as follows:

ChatGPT sticker Add to chat app Add to WhatsApp WhatsApp (minimum 3) Couldn't add sticker to WhatsApp Download sticker

Android Authority added that the minimum of three requirement comes from WhatsApp, not OpenAI.

Since the feature was discovered by parsing the APK file, it remains unclear when it will officially launch—or even whether it will be released publicly.
